page.overview:
Who is Holly Dash?

Holly Dash is a female background unicorn pony, who appears in the episodes Friendship is Magic, part 2 and Swarm of the Century, in two of IDW's comic book series, and in Gameloft's mobile game. She has a light pink coat, a yellow, blue, and purple mane, blue eyes (which are not shown in the episodes but are shown in merchandise, the comics, and the game) and a cutie mark of a strawberry. She is not named in the show or the comics and was initially called simply "Chatty Schoolteacher" in the game, but she was first named by show staff and later in merchandise.

The Friendship is Magic, part 1 Flash source file "001_C26_Unicorn_Friends_SUPER" depicts Holly Dash, S M, and Peachy Pitt and gives them the respective animation acronyms "HD", "SM", and "EP".

Holly Dash is an original character of series animator Holly Giesbrecht—who signed a contract—and is called by that name by Giesbrecht herself, who specified on April 18, 2011 that "Some co-workers dubbed me 'Holly Dash' because I had colorful hair, so my pony is named that", and Sabrina Alberghetti, both earlier than merchandise's use of the name for the character; Giesbrecht has also depicted the character's eye color as blue earlier than merchandise and (subsequently) the comics each have.

In early January 2012, Giesbrecht stated that the character isn't in the show more often "Mostly because she wasn't supposed to be there at all."
